definitions.explanation: A portion of the circumference of a circle. Used in mathematics, engineering, and design to describe curved segments.

examples.japanese: {円弧|えんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
⟦{虹|にじ}→虹：03894_niji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{円弧|えんこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A rainbow has the shape of a large arc.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンパス→コンパス：05595_konpasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{半径|はんけい}→半径：04331_hankei⟧⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{円弧|えんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Use a compass to draw an arc with a radius of five centimeters.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (circle) and {弧|こ} (arc). A mathematical and technical term for a segment of a circle's circumference. Also used more loosely to describe any curved, arc-like shape.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {円弧|えんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to draw/trace an arc
- {円弧|えんこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧: arc length
- {円弧|えんこ}⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧: arc-shaped

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弧|こ}: arc — the character alone, used in mathematics
- アーチ: arch — loanword; refers to architectural arches
- ⟦{曲線|きょくせん}→曲線：05441_kyokusen⟧: curve — a more general term for any curved line
- {弧|こ}{度|ど}: radian — the angular measure based on arc length
